title: When discipline has gone hard around pain
subtitle: For rules that need mercy to stay clean
description: These readings let inward discipline meet forgiveness before principle becomes punishment wearing a sacred name.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The shabad redirects outward marks into contentment, humility, remembrance, and conquest of the mind.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When your rule becomes harsh, let one act of forgiveness prove the mind is being conquered.

evidence.coreClaim: This path protects discipline from becoming pain’s legal system.
evidence.turn: Forgiveness keeps discipline from hardening into self-righteous punishment.
evidence.practicalImplication: Keep the rule, but remove the cruelty you were using to enforce it.
